title: `humanize.intword` Unwanted decimal value
body:
### What did you do?
Tried to have `humanize` humanize the number `1,000` to a number-word.
### What did you expect to happen?
I expected to get a number that doesn’t have a decimal value when the decimal is 0.
### What actually happened?
I got a `1.0 thousand` when I don’t want that 0 decimal place.
### What versions are you using?

* OS: Not self hosting
* Python: latest
* Humanize: latest

Please include **code** that reproduces the issue.

The [best reproductions](https://stackoverflow.com/help/minimal-reproducible-example) are [self-contained scripts](https://ericlippert.com/2014/03/05/how-to-debug-small-programs/) with minimal dependencies.

```python
print(humanize.intword(1000))
```


</issue>
